svg.title: Sakur4 architecture
svg.desc: Two harnesses reach Sakur4 over MCP; two have no MCP client and reach the daemon directly. The daemon holds eight components over a SQLite store, and probes its inference backend rather than assuming its capabilities.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Sakur4 is a subsystem, not a harness. It never calls a model and never owns the agent loop.

svg.text: The PRD's risk register notes that llama.cpp's slot API is a moving target, so Sakur4 records what it found and routes every cache decision through that.
